Beschreibung

Wir stellen Ihnen unseren stilvollen und funktionalen modernen TV-Ständer mit einem faszinierenden Design in Schwarz und Holz vor. Dieser TV-Ständer ist die perfekte Ergänzung für jedes Wohnzimmer. Er sorgt für einen eleganten und modernen Look und bietet gleichzeitig ausreichend Stauraum für Ihre Unterhaltungsutensilien. Dieser mit Präzision gefertigte TV-Ständer verfügt über Abmessungen von 190 cm (Länge) x 38 cm (Breite) x 48 cm (Höhe) und eignet sich somit für eine Vielzahl von TV-Größen. Sein durchdachtes Layout umfasst zwei Türen und zwei Schubladen, sodass Sie ausreichend Platz für die Organisation Ihrer Mediengeräte, DVDs und anderen Zubehörs haben. Die Einbeziehung von Schubladenbrettern sorgt für zusätzliche Vielseitigkeit und ermöglicht es Ihnen, den Stauraum nach Ihren Wünschen anzupassen. Die 12-Zoll-Bodenführungen ermöglichen eine reibungslose und mühelose Bewegung, sodass Sie problemlos auf Ihre Sachen zugreifen können. Die Kombination aus Schwarz und Holzfarben schafft einen optisch ansprechenden Kontrast und wertet die Gesamtästhetik Ihres Wohnzimmers auf.

Geräumiger stauraum: Sorgen Sie für Ordnung in Ihrem Wohnraum mit reichlich Stauraum durch zwei Türen und zwei Schubladen. Vielseitige schubladenboards: Passen Sie die Aufbewahrungsanordnung mit den mitgelieferten Schubladenboards für zusätzlichen Komfort an. Leichtes gleiten: Die 12-Zoll-Auszüge an der Unterseite sorgen für mühelosen Zugriff auf Ihre Mediengeräte und Ihr Zubehör. Modernes design: Die Farbkombination Schwarz und Holz verleiht jeder Wohnzimmereinrichtung einen Hauch von Eleganz. Geeignet für verschiedene tv-grössen: Mit einer Abmessung von 190 cm x 38 cm x 48 cm bietet es Platz für verschiedene TV-Größen.  ALARM

When the machine raising alarm, it usually cause by the following 3 situations, you can reset it as the case may be.

2. Water excess, beyond the MAX warning line, can trigger the alarm when the water boiling.

3. Dirty water.

 

ATTENTION

1. Do not add any other liquid such as herbal tea, essential oil, toner, it could cause the machine for spraying water.

2. Keep away from children, to prevent steam scald.

3. Do not fill water when the machine is running.

5. Do not use this machine while sleeping.

6. Please pour out the water if you don't use it in a long time.(more than a week)

 

WARM TIPS:

1. Do not use distilled water or pure water, use tap water. 

2. If you use distilled water, the sensor may not sense the PH value of it and will beep to remind you, or you can add a little salt to the distilled water. 

3. Pay attention to the maximum and minimum scale mark of the water cup.

4.Do not add any essential oils or other substances to the water.

Our Extendable cordless chainsaw & grass trimmer kit is a great garden tools to help you cut the wood and trim the grass efficiently and effortlessly. We provide a chainsaw head, a grass trimmer head, 1Pc 4in chain & guide bar, 1Pc 6in chain & guide bar, 1Pc circular saw blade and 5Pcs plastic blades, great to cut tree limbs/branches/firewood/cabinets, etc. and trim grass. 2Pcs 1500mAh rechargeable batteries allow you to do the job continuously up to 30mins for grass trimmer and 120mins for electric chainsaw. It has an excellent cutting performance with powerful pure copper motor and 32.8ft/s chain speed. You can assemble the chainsaw to 13in/56.3in/75.2in according to your needs, and assemble the grass trimmer to 56.3in/75.2in freely. A must have tool for household, garden, yard, or farm projects and a perfect gift for your dad, friends, husband and horticulturist.

Feature:

3-In-1 Pole Saw & Mini Chainsaw & Grass Trimmer: We provide a chainsaw head, a grass trimmer head, 1Pc 4in chain & guide bar, 1Pc 6in chain & guide bar, 1Pc circular saw blade, 5Pcs plastic blades, and 3 extension poles, great to use it as a mini chainsaw, as a pole saw or as a grass trimmer to cut tree limbs/branches/firewood/cabinets, and trim grass. A must have tool for household, garden, yard, or farm projects.

 

Length Adjustable: Comes with 3 extension poles, you can assemble the chainsaw to 3 length as needed and use 4in/6in chain to meet your demands. You can use it as a handheld mini chainsaw with length of 13in, or you can extend it to 56.3in or 75.2in to cut the high tree branches that you can not reach easily. Besides, the grass trimmer can be assembled to 2 different length(56.3in/75.2in) to meet your needs. The head of both chainsaw and grass trimmer can be adjusted 90° freely according to your needs.

 

Powerful Cutter & Safe Protection: Our 4in/6in mini chainsaw with built-in great pure copper motor ensures that the chain speed is up to 32.8ft/s, which has an effective cutting performance. Designed with a safety switch, you need to hold down the switch(or push up the safety button) and press the trigger simultaneously to start the machine. And an extra protective cover is provided to install in the front of the trigger to avoid accidental hurting your hands while using. 90° Rotatable bezel can prevent splash fragments. We also offer 1 pair of gloves and 1 goggle to protect your hands and eyes.

 

2Pcs 1500mAh Batteries & Cordless Design: 2Pcs 21V 1500mAh rechargeable batteries allow you to cut the wood continuously up to 30mins for grass trimmer and 120mins for electric chainsaw. Besides, its lightweight and cordless design ensure effortless wood cutting, tree pruning, grass trimming and gardening without a sore hand. The extra handle on the pole can assist your trimming, too.

 

Widely Use & Great Garden Helper: This mini chain saw is an excellent tool for all kinds of the household, garden, yard, or farm projects to cut wood, chop tree limbs, prune branches, trim grass, maintain the garden and more. A perfect gift for your dad, friends, husband, horticulturist, etc.

Note: 1. When you receive the violin, please notice that the bridge is wrapped in paper and stowed underneath the tailpiece. Don't discard it. It should be installed in the middle of the two F Holes. 2. When you receive the bow and the hairs are loose, don't worry. Use the screw to tighten the frog so that the hair has tautness. 3. When you find that part of the bow hair is broken, it is normal, please cut off the broken part and the bow can be used normally. 4. Be careful to not over tighten your bow. The hair should have a slight bounce to it without touching the stick after placing it on the strings. Usually about 1/4 of an inch distance from the low point of the curve to the hair is ideal. 5. Hold the rosin with your index finger and thumb, and thus tighten up the bow, evenly smear the rosin on the bowstring up and down. Suggested use: before smearing, rip a trace on rosin to make it powdery for quick and even smearing. Try to keep your hands away from rosin or pad with a tissue while smearing; otherwise it will become too sticky to clean. 6. If the string falls out, don't worry, it can be reinstalled, please consult customer service.

Side pocket for storage space

This sofa combines practical features with modern aesthetics – the side storage pocket holds a remote control, magazines, snacks or mobile phones, so everyday essentials are always within reach, yet discreetly concealed. Whether it's a movie night with an enclosing seating area, spontaneous overnight guests or a reading corner in everyday life: it meets every requirement with gentle intelligence.

Easy maintenance

The easy-care fabric cover is pleasantly soft, durable and easy to clean - ideal for daily use with children or pets. Whether for a spontaneous family movie night or improvised living room camping - it fits easily into any situation and becomes a reliable companion for shared moments full of laughter and cosiness.

Stylish & functional

More than just a piece of furniture – an intelligent room concept for the modern, mobile lifestyle. Whether it's frequent tenant moves, annual changes of residence by students or seasonal use in small urban apartments: it integrates into your life in the "easiest" way – easy to transport when moving, almost invisible to store and ready for use in a flash. Space blends in with life, not the other way around – the perfect solution for a mobile generation.

products.title: Bohemian-style Neck-wrap Vacation Dress
products.body_html:
Relaxed Silhouette
A loose A-line shape combined with a waist-draped pleat design flatters all body types, effectively concealing curves and creating a slimming effect. Its flowing drape adds an effortlessly elegant touch, making it perfect for various casual settings such as vacations, beaches, and markets.

Contrasting Detail Design
A deep V-neckline paired with vibrant orange trims along the sides and hem brightens the overall look against a neutral gray base. This retro-chic combination creates eye-catching style while subtly elongating the neck line.

Breathable, Skin-Friendly Fabric
Made from lightweight, slightly crinkled sheer fabric that offers excellent breathability and prevents sweat buildup. With a soft drape and subtle texture, it feels cool and comfortable in summer, evoking a laid-back vacation vibe.

Functional Details
Hidden side pockets provide convenient storage for phones, lipsticks, and small essentials. Adjustable shoulder straps allow for a customized fit, accommodating different shoulder shapes for greater comfort.

Versatile Styling Options
Wear it solo as a standout summer dress or layer over cardigans or denim jackets. Paired with straw hats and woven bags, it easily transitions between bohemian, casual, and vintage styles.

products.title: Floral Lace Cut-Out Maxi Dress With Thigh-High Slit
products.body_html:
Product Details

Overview

The Nocturne Lace Gown is a masterpiece of dark romanticism and modern allure. Crafted from intricate floral guipure lace, this floor-sweeping silhouette features daring waist cut-outs and a dramatic thigh-high slit, balancing modest high-neck tailoring with contemporary edge. Designed for high-profile evening events, it creates a statuesque profile that is both timeless and provocative.

Design Features

  • Neckline: Elegant high-standing mandarin collar for a refined, regal look.

  • Sleeves: Delicate cap sleeves that provide minimal coverage while maintaining a structured shoulder line.

  • Cut-Outs: Symmetrical side-waist cut-outs designed to accentuate the natural curve of the waist.

  • Skirt: A slim-fit maxi skirt featuring a bold front slit for ease of movement and a hint of skin.

  • Back: Secure zip-back closure for a seamless, tailored fit.

Specifications

  • Material: Premium Corded Floral Lace (100% Nylon/Polyester blend).

  • Lining: Integrated nude-toned partial lining for a sheer-effect contrast and optimal coverage.

  • Stretch: Minimal stretch to maintain the structured lace pattern.

  • Length: Full-length maxi (approx. 60 inches from shoulder to hem).

Size & Fit

  • Fit: Slim fit through the bodice and hips. We recommend sizing up if you are between sizes.

  • Model Info: Model is 168cm, wearing a size Small.

Care Instructions

  • Professional dry clean only.

  • Store flat to avoid stretching the lace delicate fibers.

  • Keep away from sharp jewelry to prevent snagging.

Styling Tip

"Let the intricate lace be the focal point by pairing this gown with sleek pulled-back hair and statement gold drop earrings. Finish the look with minimalist black stiletto sandals for an elongated, elegant silhouette."

Product Features

  • Pure fun: This all-in-one solution combines an inflatable slide, paddling pool, basketball court, water guns, play kitchen and ring toss game to meet the diverse play needs of children.
  • Sturdy and Safe Construction: Reinforced, inflatable edges and a padded floor effectively reduce the risk of collision, making it suitable for use in gardens, lawns and outdoor activities.
  • New play opportunities in summer: Integrated water guns and a spray function on the slide as well as a large paddling pool allow children to have splashing water fun outdoors.
  • Social and educational interaction: Various games such as play kitchen, basketball and ring toss promote social skills and hand-eye coordination, stimulating imagination and creativity.
  • Easy to assemble and disassemble: Equipped with a powerful 580W blower, the device can be inflated quickly and conveniently. Thanks to the compact folding mechanism, it is easy to store and transport.

Descriptions

Long Description:

Made of sturdy, waterproof Oxford fabric, this inflatable water park for kids offers durability as well as a comfortable and safe play experience. With a powerful 580W blower, the castle can be inflated in just a few minutes, allowing children to quickly immerse themselves in a world of fun. It combines a slide, a paddling pool, water pistols, basketball hoops, a play kitchen and a ring toss game. This allows children to have fun in the cool water and at the same time experience various interactive games that promote their social skills and hand-eye coordination. The slide can be connected to a water spray system for even more refreshment. The sturdy construction and padding provide additional safety. Quick to set up and easy to store, the water park is perfect for family gardens, patios, or garden parties – the ideal choice for summer entertaining.

1.Not suitable for children under 3 years old. 2.The max. load capacity is 135kg, suitable for a maximum of 3 children. 3.Due to manual measurements, there is an error of a few centimeters. 4.The blower must be on all the time while the children are playing.

Classic thick flannel fabric, comfortable and versatile

The sofa is made of high-quality thick flannel, with soft texture and classic appearance. The fabric is skin-friendly, durable and not easy to fade. The recessed design prevents the mattress from shifting, and the slatted spacing also provides gaps for air circulation, which extends the life of the mattress and makes the bed both comfortable and affordable.

  • Please note: The bed frame does not include a mattress and comes with simple tools and instructions for quick assembly. 4. Loosen the fasteners, remove 1 end while being prepared to fight the pressure in the strut, move the end so it's away from the bodywork, remove the other end, install that end of the new 1, wrestle the other end into place and tighten up.

Stage 1: in the budding stage, before the teeth grow out, the baby already feels uncomfortable on the gums. The gum of the first stage can be put in the refrigerator, and the cool touch can relieve the swelling and pain of the baby's gums before teething.
Stage 2: at the age of 6 months, most babies begin to grow a pair of incisors in the lower jaw. At this time, frozen gums massage soft incisors should be used to relieve discomfort; Hard gums can massage pulp, and uneven gum surface will also stimulate the development of baby's brain.
Stage 3: When the baby grows four upper and lower teeth, it is recommended to choose pacifier chewing gum which is similar in shape to pacifier, lighter in weight and easier to grasp. The soft and hard texture layer can not only massage the pulp around the newly grown teeth, but also let the baby experience the feeling of chewing.
The fourth stage: 1-2 years old. 1-2 years old is the growth period of deciduous teeth. Select the fixed teeth gums that can reach a wide range of teeth and have baffles to prevent contact with the throat. The texture layer mixed with soft and hard can reduce swelling and pain caused by big teeth, help to enhance tooth development and exercise chewing ability.

products.title: Low Profile Engine Bay Cowl Filter Set 2 Pcs HVAC Delete Cabin Filters For E81 E82 E87 E88 E90 E91 E92 E93 E84
products.body_html:
Innenraumluftfilter für BMW E82 E88 E90 E91 E92 E93 X1 E84 335i 135i 328i 325i 


E-Serien-Besitzer wissen, dass das Entfernen der Motorhaube und des HVAC-Filtersystems nicht nur das Gewicht des Fahrzeugs reduziert, sondern auch die Kühlung des gesamten Motorraums verbessert, die Wartung des Motors und der DME-Box erleichtert und es dem Fahrer ermöglicht, den laufenden Motor besser zu hören. 

Aber es stellt sich immer die Frage, wie man verhindert, dass Staub und Schmutz in das interne Belüftungssystem gelangen. 

Aus diesem Grund haben wir eine einfache Version des Klimaanlagenfilters eingeführt, die speziell für diese Aufgabe entwickelt wurde.


Merkmale:

【Reduziertes Fahrzeuggewicht】Reduziert das Gewicht um ca. 10 lbs, ohne Haube und HVAC-Filtersystem.

【Bessere Kühlung des Motorraums】Der Motor klingt ohne Motorhaube besser und ermöglicht eine bessere Kühlung.

【Klimaanlagenfilter】Hält Schmutz und Ablagerungen aus dem inneren Belüftungssystem fern.

【Einfache Kontrolle und Wartung】Einfacher Zugang zu DME-Boxen oder Wartung von Zündkerzen, Ventildeckeln, etc.

【Einfache Installation und Reinigung】Zur Reinigung mit Wasser abspülen, trocknen lassen und wieder einbauen. Nicht einölen.


Spezifikationen:

Zustand: Brandneu

Typ: Kutten-Filter

Farbe: Schwarz

Artikel enthalten: 2pcs Kuttenfilter


Hinweis: Schrauben sind nicht im Lieferumfang enthalten, Sie können 07147146539 oder ähnlich große Schrauben verwenden.

Details

Ein vielseitiger Helfer in der Küche

Der ounlink Gemüseschneider ist ein vielseitiges All-in-One-Küchengerät, das sich perfekt für die Zubereitung von Salaten, Salsa, Zwiebeln, Knoblauch und vielem mehr eignet. Er liefert schnelle, gleichmäßige Ergebnisse und hat ein Fassungsvermögen von 1,5 Litern. Das platzsparende Design macht sperrige Geräte in kleinen Küchen überflüssig, während der blaue Ablauf die Verschmutzung minimiert. Dank des transparenten Gehäuses mit rutschfestem Boden können Sie den Fortschritt beim Schneiden von Gewürzen wie Karotten, Gurken, Kürbis, Zucchini und Ingwer überwachen. Da er keinen Strom benötigt, kann der ounlink Gemüsehobel überall eingesetzt werden.

 

für Ihren Bedarf an Gemüsehobel

Hochwertige Küchengeräte machen die Zubereitung köstlicher Mahlzeiten zu Hause schnell und einfach. Der gemüseschneider wird Ihr neuer bester Freund in der Küche sein!
